photo.fileTitle: File:Pro-Islamic Republic of Afghanistan rally, Rotterdam (21 August 2021) 22.jpg
photo.caption: Anti-Taliban rally in Rotterdam, 21 August 2021
photo.description: A rally asking for support for the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan protesting the Taliban (Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan) following their victory, which was held in the Rotterdamer neighbourhood of the Centrum, Rotterdam Rechter Maasoever.
